scripts.dev:all: npx --yes concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist/client', 'dist', {recursive: true, force: true});"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
